provenance.auxiliary_reprojection_px: result.diagnostics.reprojection_error_per_camera, keyed by each auxiliary camera's name
provenance.camera_height_range_m: min/max of cc.water_z - cc.extrinsics.C[2] over primary cameras; identical to camera_parameters.csv's h_c_m column
provenance.inter_corner_mae_mm: mean(abs(signed_errors)) from output_dir/spatial_measurements.csv (load_spatial_measurements), converted to mm
provenance.inter_corner_rmse_mm: sqrt(mean(signed_errors**2)) from output_dir/spatial_measurements.csv (load_spatial_measurements), converted to mm
provenance.water_z_m: cc.water_z (shared across all cameras under shared_interface); identical to camera_parameters.csv's water_z_m column
